title: Unit suite against the release library
body: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c built against build/release/libspscring.a without the seams (13 tests): creation, capacity, FIFO order, full and empty, the refusals, the size across a wrap, reset, destroy, NULL everywhere. Pipeline stage unit-tests-release.
rationale: The shipped code, not an instrumented one.

title: Unit and integration suites under coverage, with the seams
body: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c (17 tests, the allocation and lock-free seams included) and tests/ITs/integration_tests.c (3 tests) on one instrumented object; gcovr gates lines and branches of app/spscring.c at 100 %. Pipeline stage unit-tests.
rationale: Every line and every branch reached, the failure paths of creation among them.
criteria: Every test passes; lines and branches 100 %.

title: Integration suite on the release archive
body: tests/ITs/integration_tests.c against the release archive (3 tests): a simple flow, one producer and one consumer thread handing values over, an observer thread sampling the size while both run. Pipeline stage integration.
rationale: The two-thread contract through the public API only.

title: AddressSanitizer, UBSan and LeakSanitizer
body: The unit suite (17), the integration suite (3) and a reduced stress (500,000 values) under ASan, UBSan and LSan. Pipeline stage sanitizers.
rationale: Memory errors, undefined behaviour and leaks on every path the suites reach.
criteria: Every test passes; no sanitizer report.

title: ThreadSanitizer
body: The integration suite (3) and a reduced stress (200,000 values) under ThreadSanitizer, run under setarch -R, never mixed with ASan. Pipeline stage tsan (GCC_BUILD_ENABLE_TSAN=1).
rationale: A data race between the producer and the consumer is what this ring must never have.
criteria: Every test passes; no race reported.

title: Stress: 8,000,000 hand-offs, exactly once, in order
body: tests/stress/stress_mt.c on the release archive: one producer pushes 1..8,000,000 against one consumer through a ring of 4096; a per-value bitmap aborts on a duplicate or an out-of-order value. Pipeline stage stress-run.
rationale: Millions of hand-offs at full speed, the two roles the ring is for.
criteria: STRESS TEST PASSED; every value seen once, in order.

title: ABI layout and exports
body: utils/check_abi.sh: app/spscring.h against abi/layout.txt, and the release shared object's exports against utils/spscring.map (exactly nine functions, version node SPSCRING_1). Pipeline stages abi and abi-exports.
rationale: The interface a consumer links is the one declared.

title: The installed packages
body: utils/smoke_test_package.sh: the debs built, installed into a scratch root, tests/package/smoke.c compiled against the installed header and library alone and run. Pipeline stages package and package-smoke.
rationale: The delivery works on its own, not only the source tree.
criteria: The smoke program round-trips a value.

title: Hardening and the glibc ceiling
body: kyr-build's check_hardening on the release artifacts (RELRO, immediate binding, non-executable stack, canaries, fortify, no RPATH, versioned soname, position-independent archive) and the glibc-ceiling stage. Pipeline stages package and glibc-ceiling.
rationale: The release binary as the platform ships it.

title: Static analysis and the warning gates
body: The audit profile's build (the whole warning set, -Werror and GCC's -fanalyzer) and kyr-build's gates legacy-names, pragmas, tables and warnings. Pipeline stages build:audit, legacy-names, pragmas, tables, warnings.
rationale: Zero warnings under the strictest set; no diagnostic switched off.

title: Inspection of the memory ordering and the progress
body: A line-by-line inspection of push, pop, is_full, is_empty and size against ISO/IEC 9899:2011 7.17: each counter written by one side only, read relaxed by its owner and with acquire by the other side, published with release; push and pop straight-line code with no loop, lock or system call (SDD 5.3).
rationale: The acquire/release pairing and the wait-freedom are properties of the code, which a test can corroborate and never prove.
criteria: Every check of the inspection's list holds; the threaded suites under ThreadSanitizer corroborate it.
